title: billing.account_changed
description: Changed is published by admin when something the back-office shows to staff changed: a user, a server, a report, the staff itself or the investigation file of a user or a server. It carries no data, only what to ask for again, and the staff members who should be told, so notifications can push it to them without knowing who is staff. It is not signed: the worst a forged one can do is make a staff screen ask again for what it already shows.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

resource.description: Qué volver a pedir: usuarios, servidores, reportes, el equipo de staff, un expediente o las métricas.
